title: Hire Overseas Workers UK | Sponsor Licence Help Manchester
description: Hiring from overseas? IAA-regulated sponsorship help for UK employers: sponsor licences, Certificates of Sponsorship, 2026 costs and compliance.
intro: To employ most overseas workers, your business needs a Home Office sponsor licence. We help you apply, set up the systems the Home Office expects, and assign Certificates of Sponsorship to new hires.

sections.heading: How UK employers hire from overseas
sections.text: To employ most workers from outside the UK, your business needs a sponsor licence from the Home Office. Once you have one, you assign a Certificate of Sponsorship to each worker, who then applies for their visa, usually a Skilled Worker visa.

sections.heading: Check the role before you start
sections.text: Since July 2025, most new Skilled Worker roles must be at degree level and pay at least £41,700 a year, or the going rate if higher. Many roles that used to be eligible no longer are. Before you pay for a sponsor licence, we check that your roles qualify.

sections.heading: The real cost of sponsoring a worker
sections.text: The employer pays the sponsor licence fee, the Certificate of Sponsorship and the Immigration Skills Charge, and these can't be passed on to the worker. For a small business hiring one worker for 3 years, the employer's Home Office costs come to over £2,500, before the worker's own visa fee and health surcharge.

sections.heading: Sponsorship help for Manchester businesses
sections.text: We help employers across Manchester and the North West, and businesses anywhere in the UK remotely, with licence applications, assigning certificates, right to work checks and ongoing compliance.
